## About

I'm a psychopedagogue and instructional designer based in Brazil. I started in 2014 evaluating search results and later language models, for platforms including Leapforce, Appen, Teamwork and OneForma, which gave me technical intuition that most instructional designers don't have.

My foundation is psychopedagogy and epistemology. In practice that means I ask what it means to know something before I decide how to teach it.

Skills: Instructional Design, LLM Evaluation, Cognitive Science, E-Learning, Epistemology, AI & Education, LXD, Python, Vanilla JS, Claude API, n8n, Figma, Prompt Engineering, ADDIE, UDL, NVC

## Projects

### Conflict Resolution Simulator (ConflictSim)
URL: https://conflictsim.com
Case study: https://raquelgmiranda.github.io/case-study.pdf
Type: Interactive training, AI-powered
Stack: Vanilla JS, Claude API
Year: 2025-26

A role-play simulator for four workplace conflict archetypes. Characters respond to how you communicate: empathy opens them up, blame shuts them down. Each character runs on its own prompt with a consistent psychological profile. A second model reads the transcript afterwards and gives structured feedback across four skill dimensions. Built in vanilla JS on purpose: no framework, no build step.

Four scenarios: Lucas (missed deadline), Rita (idea theft), Daniel (scope creep), Marina (angry client). Each runs in Normal and Challenge mode.

### Selly, AI Sales Coach
URL: https://b2b-sales-trainer.netlify.app
Case study: https://raquelgmiranda.github.io/selly-case-study.pdf
Type: AI coach, B2B sales training
Stack: Vanilla JS, Claude API, Netlify Functions
Year: 2025-26

A conversational coach for B2B sales reps. Users pick what they struggle with and how much scaffolding they want, and Selly pushes back when answers are vague. Feedback quotes the rep's own words, because abstract feedback is easy to ignore. The design started with a 34-page knowledge base written before the system prompt. Five topic areas: Objection Handling, Discovery, Reading the Buyer, Timing and Qualification, Value Selling. Two modes: Coach (minimal scaffolding) and Guide (more structure).

### The Next Button (phishing training)
URL: https://raquelgmiranda.github.io/phishing.html
Type: Interactive e-learning, information security
Year: 2026

A three-minute phishing module that opens as a deliberately dull training slide. Clicking "Next" out of habit triggers the lesson: that reflex is what phishing exploits. Learners then sort a fictional inbox, get feedback marked on the email they misjudged, and face a harder second round where the sender's account is genuine but compromised.

### Croma Archive (in development)
A course company co-founded by Raquel around the history of Brazilian graphic design. The first course is in development for Udemy.
